content: Clause Alignment. We applied our clause alignment algorithm on the 35K aligned bilingual paragraphs and obtained 517K aligned bilingual clauses. The reason we use clause alignment algorithm instead of sentence alignment is because we can construct more aligned sentences more flexibly and conveniently. To be specific, we can get multiple additional sentence level bilingual pairs by “data augmentation”.
